name: desk-yw-smoke
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk 2>&1 | tee {out}/desk_stdout.txt; grep -q 'year weighting ON' {out}/desk_stdout.txt
summarize: grep -E 'year weighting ON|rebalance ON|stratum weights composed' {out}/desk_stdout.txt | cut -c1-300
note: E029 smoke: the year weighting prints its shares and a 3-epoch run completes
